about: every N64 input bindable (2026-11-19, roster_ctl): F2 > CONTROLS > CONTROLLER BUTTONS opened in the arcade's QA Royal Rumble (qa_op works there, not in a QA singles demo: logic.c qa_on 1 returns before the F2 menu) (qa_op 22), a capture of SPECIAL (STICK PUSH) asked for (qa_bind_row 19), then the scripted pad's R3 (rightstick) binds it -- the exe saves controls_n64.json and logs '[pads] controllers: SPECIAL = R3'; the later R3 presses push player 1's stick ('[pads] player 1: SPECIAL held'). Read the log and the copy's controls_n64.json after the run.

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: the capture ended with a binding set and saved
